differences.command: while true; do typeset X=sub | rmdir ~; break; done
while true; do X=/usr | rmdir sub/..; break; done
while true; do X=. | rmdir sub/..; break; done
if true; then X=. | rmdir sub/..; fi
for Y in one; do export X=.. | rmdir .; done
for Y in one; do readonly X=/ | rmdir /usr; done

while true; do typeset X='*' | rmdir *; break; done
